The global application conftest imports anyio/FastAPI/httpx and failed before the reviewed autonomy tests ran. The failure was captured on run 39439612414 at main SHA 7e1ca0edc7be2c099bf3638ead49f994a2cefde1. Protected main fix #945 was independently exercised in fresh run 39443606247 (30+24 tests, PASS) and exact-cache recovery 39443918486 (PASS, attempts unchanged at one per task).
records.mandatory_action: Keep --noconftest on the exact reviewed pytest-only queue commands. Preserve exact queue fingerprint/cache checks; use fresh runs after queue changes. PASS applies only to fixed offline queue execution, not AWS deployment, continuous AI coding or trading.

records.diagnosis: Windows standalone audit counted same-session 1m ETF float-drift rows as research-label eligible before post-close, while the isolated cache builder only permits the 1m float-tolerance path after 15:02 China time. Keep event/source admission blocked for UNPROVEN/UNKNOWN source proof while allowing fresh schema-valid provisional research; preserve event gate status on unchanged polls.

records.diagnosis: The CN historical adapter clipped explicit 15m/1H date ranges to a 365-day provider lookback, and stockdata-hub's symbol+period cache does not distinguish date ranges. Regression tests on main 339e419 reproduced both periods requesting only 365 days for a 2016-to-2026 query. The adapter fix now passes the bounded full range and bypasses the cache for explicit starts; actual EastMoney history back to 2016 remains NOT_VERIFIED because the read-only provider probe was disconnected before returning data.
records.mandatory_action: Keep explicit intraday lookbacks bounded and bypass the range-unaware cache. Before claiming 2016 coverage, verify observed earliest/latest timestamps and source identity for 000001 at both 15m and 60m; keep provider finality and all Radar/trading gates independent.

records.diagnosis: The clean-retry fix (#968) exposed the underlying failure on exact main run #61: AWS CLI v2 ZIP extraction still returned ENOSPC in the probe's /tmp staging directory before any TickFlow provider call. Repeated extraction retries cannot fix a volume-capacity limit. Exact main run #39715081279 at SHA e491727 confirmed pinned SDK import and one realtime_quote operation completed; sanitized output intentionally omitted quote values. No K-lines, depth, WebSocket, retries, Radar admission or trades were used.
records.mandatory_action: Keep the pinned boto3/botocore bootstrap and do not restore AWS CLI archive extraction. If the same bootstrap path fails on a new SHA, investigate the new signature first. This mitigation proves only a single realtime quote operation; quote values, currentness, K-lines, bar finality and all Radar/trading gates remain independently unverified/blocked.

records.diagnosis: The isolated research collector routed 15m/60m warmup requests through TickFlow's intraday endpoint, which returns current-session bars only. Historical klines.get/batch support explicit start_time/end_time; the collector must fetch historical warmup separately and retain intraday only for current-session updates.
records.mandatory_action: Use bounded explicit history windows through TickFlow klines.get/batch for 15m, 60m and D1; merge with current-session intraday bars by label; enforce 96/24/60 warmup rows and fail closed with ROW_COUNT_BELOW_MIN. Keep source, timestamp semantics, currentness, finality and all Radar/trading gates independently unqualified until exact deployed SHA and cloud readback are verified.

records.diagnosis: The AWS private-frame progress auditor capped D1 at 40 rows while the cache writer requires 60, so valid D1 history became UNKNOWN diagnostics. It also labeled 145-240 one-minute rows as 97_TO_144. Exact-base offline regression reproduced three failures; the focused 27-test suite passes with aligned D1 cap and an accurate 145_TO_240 enum. This is diagnostic mitigation only; exact-head CI and post-merge cloud audit remain separate.
records.mandatory_action: Keep private-frame maximums aligned with the real cache writer and update the workflow enum allowlist together. Verify each period at its writer limit and one row above; reject oversize frames and export no prices or timestamps. Do not interpret off-session sequence stability or repaired diagnostics as currentness, finality or Radar/trading admission.

records.diagnosis: AWS audit 39901934538 confirms the collector rejects the separate current-session hourly increment under the historical four-row minimum. A normal morning has zero, one or two elapsed hourly bars, so valid multi-session warmup is discarded and Radar publishes no evaluation. Deterministic batch and single-route morning regressions fail on the base revision; missing-evaluation reader also suppresses independent heartbeat evidence.
records.mandatory_action: Validate sparse current-session increments separately and merge into strictly validated history; preserve all row checks, quarantine, depth and admission restrictions. Verify exact deployed collector/Radar/MCP SHA and in-session readback independently. Missing evaluation must expose bounded independent worker heartbeat, never source/data PASS.

Radar must retain all row/continuity checks and record_only/currentness/finality restrictions. Verify exact-head CI, deployment and current-session source/consumer readback independently.

Do not change OHLC eligibility, source finality, currentness or admission; independently verify the merged audit runtime.

Compare immutable files without claiming authenticated provenance or finality; expose late baseline and missing/invalid evidence explicitly. records.diagnosis: Three OpenD publishers reused a fixed destination.tmp path. A deterministic two-writer fsync barrier reproduced FileNotFoundError on replace in heartbeat, canonical and daily publishers. This is a confirmed code defect, not a proven cause of the 2026-10-23 production file loss. Unique same-directory temporary files now isolate writes, reject nonfinite JSON, clean failed staging, and preserve the last publication on pre-replace failure. Production deployment/recovery remains NOT_VERIFIED.
records.mandatory_action: Use the shared runtime publisher; preserve source/runtime/sequence and freshness validation. Do not treat atomic per-file publication as a cross-file transaction, restart recovery, or persistent storage across /run deletion. Obtain actual service and journal evidence before attributing the October 23 incident.

records.diagnosis: Actual CanonicalSnapshotRadarWorker failure results leave source safety fields unknown. Deployment remains NOT_VERIFIED.

records.diagnosis: Real AWS run39980775405 observed the exact old runner active for33811s with zero restarts, three missing evidence files and117 recent connection-failure lines. Its runner SHA256 matches the896f05d4 installer exactly. Pinned futu-api10.11.7108 source confirms unbounded synchronous constructor retry; initial connection and warmup occur before first heartbeat and callback deadline, while Type=simple provides no startup deadline. This establishes an unsupervised pre-publication SDK-I/O failure mechanism; the precise blocked call and upstream gateway cause need independent host evidence. Code now publishes blocked startup evidence before connection and uses existing systemd notify/startup/watchdog supervision; deployment/recovery NOT_VERIFIED. Guarded deployment40066832209 at b972b282 now publishes the exact-SHA blocked startup heartbeat but failed roughly15minutes later. Subsequent MCP readback shows a different runtime ID still at sequence0/no callbacks/no snapshot: startup publication works, quote recovery remains failed; exact host timeout/restart and connection reason require bounded journal evidence.
records.mandatory_action: Do not equate ACTIVE, TCP listening or READY with quote qualification. Require blocked startup heartbeat before provider construction, finite systemd startup/stop deadlines, readiness/watchdog only after successful full heartbeat publication, actual gateway recovery and fault injection. Preserve guarded restart windows and all trading gates.

records.mandatory_action: Test actual import under python -S before cloud use; do not infer dependency isolation from submodule source alone. Preserve old callers through compatibility exports, never add full strategy dependencies to quote-only AWS merely to satisfy import. Check repo SHA, generated runner hash and process separately after failed installation; no unchanged blind retries.
